about: Organoleptic and process notes used only by format suggestions. They are not clinical claims and they do not change BCS, delivery, or ModernizedSKU decisions.

HB-TURM.note: Turmeric rhizome is bitter and slightly pungent. Curcumin also stains.

HB-BERB.note: Berberine is an intensely bitter isoquinoline alkaloid.

HB-BOSW.note: Boswellia gum resin is bitter and resinous.

HB-HARI.note: Haritaki pericarp is rich in hydrolysable tannins and tastes astringent.

HB-AMLA.note: Amla fruit is sour and astringent.

HB-CINN.note: Cinnamaldehyde is a volatile oil constituent and is lost with high heat.

HB-ELAA.note: Eucalyptol, the cardamom marker, is volatile and is lost with high heat.
